name: Plants vs. Zombies
summary: Plants vs. Zombies Web Version is a free online Adobe Flash version of the game that was available at PopCap Games' official website and Pogo.com. There are three modes: Adventure Mode, Survival and Puzzle. In the Adventure Mode of this version, the player can only progress until they finish level 2-4 (level 2-2 in the Pogo version) before they must start again as a new player. However, if one unlocked the Survival and Puzzle modes on one computer previously, they will be able to continue playing those modes.
